info.name: Texas Instruments Product Information Financial Products API

params.name: partNumber
params.description: TI part number (OPN). URL-encode special characters (e.g., /NOPB becomes %2FNOPB).

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency code for pricing data (e.g., USD, EUR)

items.docs: Retrieves real-time inventory availability, pricing breaks, future inventory forecasts, and product metadata for a specific TI part number. Part numbers containing /NOPB must be URL-encoded (/ becomes %2F).
Retrieves inventory and pricing data for all available TI part numbers. Rate limited to 1 request every 4 hours (6 per day). Returns the full catalog for bulk import use cases.
